messages:
alex: Heads-up: prepping a hotpatch for quant-bridge kernel (matmul v2 NVLink fix). Targeting a short window 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight. Need pin strategy + rollback triggers. @maya @nate

maya: ack. what's the canary slice? my preference 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, pause between stages for 10m.

sam: please include perf smoke: p95 tokens/s and mem RSS. If p95 increases > 8% or we see OOMs, roll back. Also watch A/B diffs.

deploybot: deploybot: initiating rollout request created by alex. plan: quant-bridge-hotpatch@sha256:abcd1234 -> slices 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. automatic pause 10m after each stage. run `deploy status roll/6178901234` to follow.

ops_lead: make sure staging has the new kernel baked. @alex did QA cover the tiled matmul flaky case? we need a green staging smoke.

alex: Staging run passed our regression harness. Key test I ran:
```
./run_regressions --case=tiled-matmul-quant --iters=200
# result: 0 failures
```

maya: adding smoke script to deploybot hook. We'll collect: latency p50/95/99, error rate, OOM count, GPU mem highwater, and inference mismatch metric. Also I'll draft release notes.

nate: Rollback criteria suggestion:
- error rate > 0.5% averaged over 5m
- p95 latency +8% vs baseline
- any OOM or GPU mem spike >95%
If triggered, deploybot should auto-pin previous bundle and notify #eng-oncall.

alex: Agree. Also add 'inference output mismatch rate' using our evaL harness: if mismatch >1% over 15m -> rollback. This catches subtle correctness regressions.

deploybot: note: auto-pin implemented. Current default pin TTL = 2h. Recommend set pin TTL = 6h for this hotpatch to allow proper investigation.

sam: set canary observation longer: 1h observation at the 10% stage (we need more samples for mismatch checks).

maya: Release-note blurb draft:
'quant-bridge: fix NVLink matmul edge-case causing occasional OOMs on tiled quant workloads; improves stability for long-context batches.'

alex: I'll send final RN to #docs after deploy starts. Ops: oncall = @nate tonight. @deploybot please annotate rollout with `hotpatch-hotfix-6178901234`.

deploybot: annotated rollout: tag=hotpatch-hotfix-6178901234. live link: https://deploys.internal/rollout/6178901234 (internal).

nate: :thumbsup: I'll watch telemetry dashboards and be ready to pin. If I see >0.4% error rate spike I'll call immediate pin.

maya: :eyes: I'll watch smoke logs and run quick reruns if there's flapping; I can revert the smoke hook quickly if it's noisy.

alex: Final checklist before window: push image, update deploy manifest, notify customers with affected account list (low risk). All set, starting image push in 10m.
